physics-killer-04.title: Toʻqnashuv va xavfsizlik, gorizontal otilish va tortishish
physics-killer-04.topic: Toʻqnashuv va xavfsizlik, gorizontal otilish va tortishish
physics-killer-04.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-04.material: Balandligi $20\,\mathrm{m}$ bo'lgan jar chetidan to'p gorizontal yo'nalishda uloqtirilganda, jar ostidagi yerning jardan gorizontal masofasi $30\,\mathrm{m}$ bo'lgan nuqtasiga tushdi. $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ va havo qarshiligi e'tiborga olinmasa, yerga tekkan paytda to'pning tezligi va shu paytdagi tezlik yo'nalishining gorizontal tekislik bilan hosil qilgan burchagi $\theta$ ning $\tan\theta$ tartib bilan to'g'ri juftlangan javob qaysi?
physics-killer-04.thinking.0: Toʻqnashuv va xavfsizlik, gorizontal otilish va tortishish
physics-killer-04.s.s1.prompt: Balandligi $20\,\mathrm{m}$ bo'lgan jar chetidan to'p gorizontal yo'nalishda uloqtirilganda, jar ostidagi yerning jardan gorizontal masofasi $30\,\mathrm{m}$ bo'lgan nuqtasiga tushdi. $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ va havo qarshiligi e'tiborga olinmasa, yerga tekkan paytda to'pning tezligi va shu paytdagi tezlik yo'nalishining gorizontal tekislik bilan hosil qilgan burchagi $\theta$ ning $\tan\theta$ tartib bilan to'g'ri juftlangan javob qaysi?
physics-killer-04.s.s1.explain: Vertikal yo'nalishda $20=\frac12\cdot10\cdot t^2\Rightarrow t=2\,\mathrm{s}$. Gorizontal yo'nalishda $30=v_0t\Rightarrow v_0=15\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Qo'nishdan oldin $v_y=gt=20\,\mathrm{m/s}$. $v=\sqrt{15^2+20^2}=25\,\mathrm{m/s}$, $\tan\theta=\dfrac{v_y}{v_0}=\dfrac{20}{15}=\dfrac43$. Tezlik $v_0+gt=35$ deb qo'shilsa noto'g'ri javob ①, $\tan\theta$ teskari yozilsa $\frac34$ (noto'g'ri javob ②), faqat vertikal tashkil etuvchi $20\,\mathrm{m/s}$ ni tezlik deb olsa noto'g'ri javob ④.
physics-killer-04.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-04.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
